Prices change monthly in the UAE, Qatar and Bahrain and quarterly in Kuwait (where 91, 95 and diesel have been fixed since September 2016 and only Ultra 98 moves); Aramco reviews Saudi prices yearly, and Oman's are frozen at the October 2021 cap. Bahrain shows the latest official price we found (September 2026). Fuel in Bahrain is zero-rated for VAT, while UAE, Saudi and Omani prices include their VAT.

Frequently asked questions

Where is petrol cheapest in the GCC?

Kuwait: 91 at 85 fils and 95 at 105 fils a litre, about AED 1.01 and 1.25. Qatar comes next, then Saudi Arabia, Oman and Bahrain; the UAE is dearest.

What does 95 petrol cost across the GCC?

UAE AED 4.04 (November 2026), Saudi Arabia SAR 2.33, Qatar QAR 2.10, Oman 239 baisa, Kuwait 105 fils and Bahrain 247 fils (September 2026).

How often do GCC fuel prices change?

Monthly in the UAE, Qatar and Bahrain; quarterly in Kuwait (in practice only Ultra 98 moves); yearly by Aramco in Saudi Arabia; and Oman's prices are frozen at the October 2021 cap.

How much is a 60-litre fill of 95 in each country?

About AED 75 in Kuwait, 127 in Qatar, 137 in Saudi Arabia and Oman, 145 in Bahrain and 242 in the UAE.
